_about: The island's endless rounds (core/round_rules.gd). start_delay / break_seconds: seconds before round 1 and between rounds. spawn_gap: seconds between two enemies coming out of the sea, at round 1 and from round spawn_gap_full_at on. count: enemies in round n = first + per_round x (n - 1), times (1 + per_extra_player x (players - 1)). alive_cap: most alive at once, by the HOST's graphics tier. health / speed / damage: how much tougher round n is: health x (1 + per_round x (n - 1)) up to round compound_from, then x compound every round; speed and damage x (1 + per_round x (n - 1)) up to max. mix: which kinds come from which round on (weights; the entry with the highest `from` not above the round counts). boss: every `every`-th round one boss of `order` (in turn; each time the list has been gone through they get health_per_cycle times tougher) plus count x count_mult ordinary enemies. special: from round `first`, every `every` rounds: only `enemy`, count x count_mult, gaps x gap_mult, and every ammo pool is filled when it ends. spawn_ring: how far from the island's middle they come up, in metres (the sand ends at 14). regen: on the islands a player who has not been hurt for `delay` seconds heals `per_second` (0 = off). cripple: a blast that takes at least `share` of an enemy's health without killing it leaves it crawling at `speed` times its pace. enemies: their stats in round 1, as in data/enemies.json.
